common.description: A free and open collection of useful tools for everyone. Simple, private and without unnecessary complexity.

home.title: Useful tools.
home.subtitle: No unnecessary complexity.
home.intro: Free, open source and private. No accounts, no subscriptions, no limits. Everything runs in your browser whenever possible.

principles.freeText: Every core tool is free. No premium tiers, no usage limits.
principles.privateText: Processing happens in your browser whenever it can.
principles.openText: The source code is public and anyone can contribute.
principles.bilingualText: Português (Brasil) and English, with equal quality.

about.title: About
about.body1: OpenTools is an open-source collection of free, accessible and easy-to-use online utilities.
about.body2: It exists to bring useful tools together in one place, without mandatory accounts, subscriptions or artificial limits.
about.body3: Privacy comes first: tools process data locally in your browser whenever technically possible, and uploaded files are never stored.

community.title: Community
community.subtitle: Suggest tools, report problems and shape the roadmap.
community.body: OpenTools is community driven. The suggestion form is coming soon; until then you can use GitHub Issues.

footer.rights: Free by design. Open by nature. Built for everyone.
